about_item: WATERPROOF: Sealed tight to withstand full submersion, this IP68-built headlamp shines in six output modes spanning three beam colors: Green, white and red.
RECHARGEABLE PLUS: Boost your power and performance—with the optional upgrade to a secondary CR123 battery (purchased separately) that snaps into position on top of the integrated battery.
TRI-COLOR: Select from two light colors—using the white utility beam for general use and the green and red anti-glare LED to prevent night blinding, detectability and emergency signaling.

HINGED BEAM ADJUSTMENT AND HARDHAT COMPATIBLE: Shine straight ahead, upward, or downward—making the directional adjustment you need using the headlamp’s hinged, tilting head to align the beam with your gaze. Count on simplicity and steady performance with a headlamp rugged enough to wear on the outside of a hardhat.
LIFETIME WARRANTY: Backed by COAST Lifetime Warranty, you can take confidence in your product knowing it is backed by COAST’s total commitment to quality and Lifetime Warranty program.

authors_reviews.title: Great hunting lamp
authors_reviews.text: I’ve trusted Coast for several years as my dedicated hunting lights. This light is no exception. It is a bit heavy but it’s BULLET PROOF! It’s made of an aluminum body and completely waterproof. It comes with a rechargeable battery and charging cord (that has both a “C” style plug and a USB end) but also comes with a small “AAA” battery pack that holds 3 AAA batteries. This is a game changer in rechargeable hunting lamps. I keep the battery pack in my hunting bag and if I forget to charge my lamp, I simply trade the rechargeable battery out with the battery pack in seconds. So I never have to be without a head lamp. This was the biggest downfall for me with rechargeable lights and now a thing of the past. This light is very bright on high for tracking down game field dressing, and other situations when the more light you have, the better. It also has many other settings including low, red and green light. This is definitely my new go to head lamp.
authors_reviews.author: John Maxie

authors_reviews.title: Best light i have ever purchased
authors_reviews.text: Thing is like a rock that can light up so bright it can blind you. Dropped it a couple times, not even a scratch. Good headband and harness. Like 8 settings that i have all used. The turbo mode is unbelievable. High flood is bright enough for all of my applications. Done at least 3 dozen projects with it on my car, i grab it every time because its so bright and pretty light. Sticks out enough where you look a little dumb, but you will have the brightest light out of any of your buddies making fun of you. Lasts for like 4 hours on high flood. Fantastic light, would buy again 1000x over
authors_reviews.author: Jason

authors_reviews.title: Great head lamp
authors_reviews.text: I love this headlamp! Super durable and extremely bright! Very critical for when i have to work early hours on the golf course. This is the only headlamp that allows me to see my mowing/rolling lines on the greens which can be very difficult in the dark, even when using the super bright lights on the mowers. Headlamp reflects the direction of grass perfectly to help me mow the sraightest of lines in the dark. Not only is it bright but it also works great over long distances to help me spot stuck irrigation heads. The only thing that I do not like about this head lamp is that it uses special batteries. It does come its custom battery, but if you look online for a extra battery, you'll see they are either sold out, even on the coast website, or way over-priced. This headlamp does come with a insert that will take 3 AAA batterys. After checking all the specs online to find any other compatible batteries that may work, I found sticking a 18650 battery (most commonly used with vape mods) seemed to work just fine. The zx955 zithion battery is rated at 3.7v, the same as a 18650, @4000mAh. The 18650 batterys are only rated for 3000mAh, so a little less run time for the headlamp with the 18650. I would recommend this head lamp to my friends, family and coworkers.
authors_reviews.author: Richard Baker

authors_reviews.title: Bright white and red light.
authors_reviews.text: I bought this headlamp for the military because I'm tired of dim red lights other brands had to offer. This is is a bright red. Things I didn't like were the reflective strap so I swapped it out with another headband. Luckily I was able to keep the top strap as that wasn't reflective and tied it to the other. I also didn't like bright green battery indicator on the side. I covered that with electrical tape and still clicks nice.It's definitely bright and USB C rechargeable with a huge battery. Great lamp. A little on the heavy side but it does the job well.
authors_reviews.author: Justin

authors_reviews.title: ABSOLUTE. UNIT.
authors_reviews.text: This thing is an absolute unit. It's heavy duty and well built. It's brighter than the sun. The red and green lights are not as bright as I was hoping, for hunting purposes. For half the price of PEAX it's not bad at all. The only reason i dropped a star is because it is heavy as hell. With the rechargeable battery thing ways a ton. Weighs my hardhat down. But if you still need the power. Use the included AAA adapter. Cuts the weight in half.
authors_reviews.author: John R. Heilig

authors_reviews.title: Bright, reliable, and built tough
authors_reviews.text: Excellent headlamp for both work and outdoor use. The 2000-lumen beam is extremely bright and evenly spread. Battery life meets the rated time and recharges quickly. The adjustable strap is comfortable even after hours of wear. Waterproofing works as advertised—I’ve used it in heavy rain with no issues. Great balance of power, durability, and usability. Highly recommend for anyone needing dependable hands-free light.
authors_reviews.author: Shawn Gegg

authors_reviews.title: Best Headlamp I’ve Owned
authors_reviews.text: Not a negative thing to say about this headlamp. Wish it was a tad lighter in terms of weight but it’s well built with great features so the slightly heavier weight seems worth it to me. I’d say if you have a small head, or are petite in stature it might be uncomfortable but then again maybe not. Brightness is great in the woods or the marsh. Battery life seems great too. Had several people ask me about this headlamp as they were impressed with the brightness and functionality.
